scenes.title: The CIA *drugged people.*
scenes.say: This sounds like a crazy conspiracy theory. The CIA, secretly drugging people with LSD to learn mind control. But it's real. The government admitted it.

scenes.title: Project *MKUltra*
scenes.say: In 1953, at the height of the Cold War, CIA director Allen Dulles approved a secret program called MKUltra.

scenes.title: *149* subprojects
scenes.say: It was run by a chemist named Sidney Gottlieb. The CIA's surviving records list one hundred and forty-nine subprojects, at universities, hospitals, and prisons.

scenes.title: Dosed *without knowing*
scenes.say: Army scientist Frank Olson was secretly given LSD. Nine days later, he fell to his death from a New York hotel window. His family didn't learn about the LSD for twenty-two years.

scenes.title: They also *secretly drugged*:
scenes.say: In Operation Midnight Climax, men were lured to CIA safehouses, drugged, and watched through one-way mirrors. In Montreal, psychiatric patients were given huge doses of LSD and electroshock.

scenes.title: Files *destroyed*
scenes.say: In 1973, CIA director Richard Helms ordered the files destroyed. But thousands of pages of financial records had been misfiled. And they survived.

scenes.title: The verdict:
scenes.say: In 1977, the CIA's director confirmed it to the Senate. The verdict: confirmed. But did they ever achieve real mind control? There's no evidence they did.
